rationale: Rear-end motor vehicle collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15 AM yesterday; the other vehicle struck at approximately 35 mph with no braking, totaling the policyholder's car with the trunk crushed into the back seat. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist and has the other driver's insurance information on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-end collision; other vehicle going ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
